message: Power outages can feel a bit daunting, but I've found they can also be a chance to slow down and enjoy some cozy moments. I love the idea of gathering candles, making a warm drink, and maybe even breaking out some board games with the family. Just like camping indoors! If you're curious about how to prep for those moments and turn a blackout into a fun family event, check out some great tips from a trusted resource.
